purpose: A South Coast to Golden Circle loop that fits 10 autumn days at a moderate pace, with waterfalls, glaciers, black-sand coasts and northern lights chances.
routeRationale: Reykjavík start, south along the coast to Vík, east to the Jökulsárlón glacier lagoon area, back through the south, Golden Circle loop before returning to Reykjavík.
timingRationale: Late September gives shoulder-season quiet at the icons, still-open highland-edge roads without gravel, and the first reliable dark-sky chances for aurora while daylight is still ample for driving.
tradeoffs: Chose depth on the South Coast and Golden Circle over covering more of the country, given the paved-roads-only…
Two nights in each stay reduces daily driving but means fewer named towns overall.
